:::{#thm-ci-mean}

#### Confidence interval for a predicted mean

In a linear regression model with $n$ observations and $p$ coefficients,
let $\evb$ be the [OLS](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/correlation-regression.html#def-ols) estimate of $\vb$,
and let $\hat\mu(\vx) = \dprodf{\vx}{\evb}$ be the estimated mean at covariate pattern $\vx$.
A 95% [confidence interval](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/inference.html#def-confidence-interval) for $\mu(\vx) = \E{Y|\vX=\vx}$ is:

$$\mu(\vx) \in \paren{\hat\mu(\vx) \pm t_{n-p}(0.975) \cdot \HSE{\hat\mu(\vx)}}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-ci-mean.

:::
